desktopAccount.signOutBody: Sign out on this Desktop and return to this computer. Its binding, remote access preferences and running tasks are kept.
desktopAccount.setupBody: You can start working with your Bot now. To open it from your phone or another computer, sign in and bind this computer.
desktopAccount.signInLater: You can also sign in later from the bottom of the sidebar.
desktopAccount.recoveryBody: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator. They are shown only here.
desktopAccount.enrollFactorBody: Add an authenticator before binding this computer or connecting to an instance.
desktopAccount.verifyFactorBody: Complete your account’s second verification step to continue.
desktopAccount.loginHeroBody: One account for your computers and the instances shared with you.
desktopAccount.welcomeSubtitle: Computer Use, files and apps: let Vibey take over your computer.
desktopAccount.codeHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your email. You can paste it here.
desktopAccount.consentBody: {{name}} isn't one of your instances. If you continue, it will receive your account email to sign you in.
desktopAccount.switchBody: Verifying your account and instance. Tasks on this Mac keep running.
desktopAccount.offlineBody: The remote computer may be offline, or the network was interrupted. Updates are paused.
desktopAccount.localStillAvailable: Avibe on this Mac is still available. Returning will not stop tasks on the remote instance.
desktopAccount.instancesBody: Move between your Avibe instances. Tasks on this Mac keep running.
desktopAccount.localDetail: No sign-in needed · Always available here
desktopAccount.emptyBody: Sign in to Desktop on another computer to see it here.

errors.bridge: The Desktop connection is unavailable. Retry or return to your workspace.
errors.request: This step could not be completed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.code: Invalid or expired code. Try again or resend.
errors.upgrade: This instance needs to upgrade Avibe before you can open it. Upgrade it on that computer, then retry.
errors.credentials: The email or password is incorrect. Try again or use an email code.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.

desktopAccount.newEmailHelp: New email addresses are registered automatically. No password needed.
desktopAccount.passwordHelp: Sign in with an email code, then set or reset your password in Account security at avibe.bot.
desktopAccount.offlineInstructions: Open Avibe on that computer and connect it to the internet, then refresh this list.

addGuide.body: Add another computer or server to the same account, then return here to refresh the list.
addGuide.computerBody: Install Avibe Desktop, sign in with the same account, then bind that computer on its Account page.
addGuide.serverTitle: On a server or command-line installation
addGuide.serverBody: Install Avibe using the installation guide, complete setup, then run this command on that server:
addGuide.pairingBody: Follow the guided pairing flow with the same avibe.bot account. Keep the pairing key on that server; do not enter it here.

bind.notBound: Not bound yet, so your phone and other computers cannot open it.
bind.repair: This computer’s binding record has a problem this page cannot handle. Run vibe remote rebind in this computer’s terminal.
bind.unknown: This computer’s binding cannot be confirmed right now.
bind.upgrade: Update Avibe on this computer before binding it.
bind.upgradeFailed: Avibe on this computer couldn’t be upgraded.
bind.needsUpdate: Needs an update to recognize its domain
bind.recovery: Your last verification went through but has not finished saving.
bind.title: Claim your own domain
bind.existing: This computer already has this domain in your account and keeps it.
bind.limit_one: This account can hold {{count}} name, including those still waiting, and has reached it.
bind.limit_other: This account can hold {{count}} names, including those still waiting, and has reached that limit.
bind.limitPlain: This account holds as many names as it may, including those still waiting.
bind.limitDate: The earliest is expected to be released on {{date}}.
bind.takeBack: You can take back a name of your own:
bind.proofBody: Before binding, confirm once with a code sent to {{email}}.
bind.conflictTitle: This computer belongs to another account
bind.conflictBody: On avibe.bot, this computer is bound to another account. Nothing changed. To use it, sign out here and sign in with that account.

problem.unreachable: avibe.bot cannot be reached right now. This did not finish.
problem.signedOut: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again, then bind.
problem.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
problem.expired: This step expired and did not finish.
problem.busy: An earlier binding of this computer is still running. Wait a moment, then try again.
problem.notResponding: Avibe on this computer is not responding. This did not finish.
problem.changed: This computer’s binding has just changed. Nothing more was done here.
problem.codeInvalid: That code is wrong or has expired.
problem.lost: After you confirmed, avibe.bot’s reply was lost and cannot be fetched again. This computer is not bound.
problem.reauth: avibe.bot still asked to verify again. This did not finish.
problem.storage: This computer cannot save the sign-in right now. Sign in again later.
problem.unavailable: This computer cannot be bound right now. Please contact <mail>{{support}}</mail>.

bind.changed: Verified, but these changed since you confirmed: {{fields}}. Check them, then press it again.
bind.changedPlain: Verified, but something changed at avibe.bot, so press it once more.
bind.otherAccount: This computer’s binding is not under this account.
bind.signInOther: Sign in with the account it is bound to
bind.signInTitle: Sign in to claim your own domain
